svg.title: Only the customer workload is exposed
svg.desc: Nest the customer workload inside a larger intact platform perimeter. Put the board card outside both; the route reaches the workload endpoint without coloring the platform as compromised. Use the independent customer workload inside intact platform geometry to identify this setting; keep the existing labels, qualifications and foreground relationships.

**Frame:** Verso. A public endpoint labeled `CUSTOMER-HOSTED CYBERGYM WORKLOAD` sits inside a larger boundary labeled `MODAL PLATFORM — NOT COMPROMISED`. The 03:32 board card from [page 041](041.md) sits outside both, at the left margin, with a clock beside it.

**Action:** The published method meets a reachable target.

**Caption:**
> THE TARGET IS A CUSTOMER'S WORKLOAD, NOT THE PLATFORM AROUND IT.

**Provenance:** `documented` — trust boundary stated by `HF-TL`, `METR`, and Modal as quoted by `OAI-TR`.
